subject: toast architect
requested_medium: felt and toasted clay stop-motion look
art_direction: 厚吐司角色戴黑色方框眼镜，烤边像建筑立面，手持一小块黄油作模型。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a thick slice of toast as an earnest architect character. The crust is toasted clay with small baked pores, while the soft center is cream felt with a tiny face and chunky dark square glasses. Two short arms hold a plain butter cube like a scale model. Keep the feet simple and the pose formal, with a slightly lifted chin. Use a muted sage background and soft stop-motion lighting. Avoid crumbs scattered everywhere, kitchen props, lettering, or treating the toast holes as exaggerated eyes. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
